name: Default 144 domain-specific general-context cues (24 topics)
description: 144 distinct bilingual contextual ideas across 24 topics. These are not the participant’s memories or evidence. Do not use them to invent autobiographical events.

memories.cue_zh: 一般情境线索：在「日常工作中的分工、职责调整和合作」中，交接可能涉及共享文档、口头约定和未写明的职责边界；这不说明受访者本人经历过这种情况。
